sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New WARNING "Possible duplicate recording" (👯) on an artist's recordings and a release tracklist: a recording that looks like another one on the same page, by the rules of majkinetor's Fusion, ported verbatim (credited in the header): a shared ISRC (or AcoustID), or at the normal cutoff the same title and artists with lengths within 5 s; never a video beside audio, live beside studio, two venues or dates, lengths more than 30 s apart, ISRCs of one batch, or a recording with an open edit. Read from the page, no requests. The title cell is tinted; its card names the other recordings of the group, what they share, its tier (strict / normal / loose) and what was kept apart. The ⚠️ menu filters to them, and the title column's 📊 has a new section "Duplicate recordings - Group" with one entry per group. Mockup approved 2026-11-20: https://claude.ai/artifact/LCthm5p9EiftZC6znZsqVB.

Three settings under ⚠️ FINDINGS: "Find possible duplicate recordings" (sa_findings_rec_dup), "how close is a match" (sa_findings_rec_dup_cutoff: Auto = strict on an artist's recordings, normal on a release; or strict, normal, loose) and the tint (sa_findings_tint_rec_dup), all on.

The grouping never compares all pairs: an ISRC/AcoustID index, and for the normal and loose cutoffs title blocks (a prefix filter over the words, exact for Fusion's word test, and the title's two ends for its spelling test), walked in Fusion's own order, so the groups are Fusion's (checked against its all-pairs loop on Tom Petty's 2,630 recordings: identical at all three cutoffs; _computeRecDupCtx(), _recDupGroups(), _recDupCandidatePairs(), _recDupRecord(), _recDupCommentSetting(), _cmpDupHtml()).
